items.title: Scottish government weighs risks and rewards of first bond issue
items.summary: Ministers plan to raise up to £1.5bn through newly nicknamed kilts to fund long-term capital projects, though economists warn borrowing costs will exceed UK government rates.

items.title: Aurora secures investment from IA Capital Group to scale algorithmic underwriting platform
items.summary: Managing general agent and algorithmic underwriting provider Aurora has secured funding from IA Capital Group to expand its AI-native platform across specialty and complex commercial lines.

items.title: Hymans Robertson launches AI tool for third-party administration
items.summary: Hymans Robertson has introduced an artificial intelligence tool designed to reduce manual tasks for its third-party administration teams.

items.title: Aviva Investors launches Emerging Market Debt Opportunities fund
items.summary: Aviva Investors has expanded its fund range with the introduction of an Emerging Market Debt Opportunities strategy.

items.title: St. James's Place appoints Ruben Mutsaers as head of strategic asset allocation
items.summary: St. James's Place has appointed Ruben Mutsaers to oversee strategic asset allocation across its multi-asset range.

items.title: Boost secures Lloyd's Coverholder approval and expands reinsurance panel
items.summary: Specialty managing general agent platform Boost has obtained Lloyd's Coverholder approval and added nine new global reinsurance partners to its panel.
